changelog:
Opening a category in a very large catalog is much faster, and a background index rebuild that fails now says so in Settings.

WHAT CHANGED

- Opening a category, or a series' episodes, in a catalog of a million channels or more takes a few milliseconds instead of about a third of a second. The phone read the whole provider to fill one category's page; it now reads just that category.
- After a large import, the indexes that make browsing and search fast are rebuilt in the background. If that rebuild fails, it is tried again, and if it still fails, Settings says so under the refresh. The rebuild also waits for an import that is still running, instead of competing with it.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.6.2: closing the picture-in-picture window stops the channel, and a dark-mode switch keeps it playing.
